types.name: strategies.v1.Bot.PauseReason
types.doc: PauseReason is why a PAUSED bot paused, beside the status_reason text.

values.name: BOT_DECIDED
values.doc: The bot's own code paused it; status_reason carries the bot's message.

values.name: FAILURES_IN_A_ROW
values.doc: Its calls failed too many times in a row.

values.name: ENVIRONMENT_RESET
values.doc:
The environment was reset, and every bot paused until its user starts
 it again.

values.name: UNRECORDED_ORDER
values.doc:
The bot found one of its own orders whose placement it hadn't
 recorded, for example after a restart, and paused so you can check its
 state; status_reason says so.

values.name: STOPPING
values.doc:
Being stopped: a stop was recorded, and the bot has not yet reported
 it complete. A stopped bot reads STOPPING until its stop is reported
 complete to the service.

values.name: STOPPED
values.doc:
Stopped by the user. After KEEP_ORDERS, its open orders belong to its
 subaccount and its in-flight orders are settled; after CANCEL_ORDERS,
 every one of its orders has ended. Read only once the bot's stop has
 been reported complete to the service; until then the bot reads
 STOPPING.

values.name: PAUSED
values.doc:
Paused, by itself, after an environment reset, after its calls
 failed too many times in a row, or because it found one of its own
 orders whose placement it hadn't recorded: status_reason says why.
 Its orders stay.
 Read only once the bot's pause has been reported to the service;
 until then a paused bot reads RUNNING. A paused bot that is being
 stopped reads STOPPING.
